p7_1_findings_for_the_register.finding: Fm3 and Fm4 are ALREADY IMPLEMENTED and working in production. Commit d85e2df (2026-08-17) widened `dod_topic`'s ordinal group to `([A-Za-z]?\d{1,2}[a-z]?)` and moved it above `thrust` with a negative lookbehind; the plan's 8.9 what-changed note records this, and §15's P7 checklist, §18.1's P7 table and P5's closeout recommendation table all still read BUILD IN P7. Measured live this session: 356612 returns 7 spans, method heading_font, family dod_topic, confidence low -- the seven topics FAMILY_TAXONOMY.md recorded.
p7_1_findings_for_the_register.consequence: P7.2's remaining content is BUG-2 alone (the ASCII-hyphen rejection in `dod_topic`, `component` and `technical_category`), which is still open and still real: all three patterns admit `:`, `.`, en-dash and em-dash and not `-`.

p7_1_findings_for_the_register.finding: The ROSES adapter's `native` children never reach the production subtopic path. `nasa_roses.subtopic_children` is called only from tests and `tools/run_cov4_validation.py`; `subtopic_fields` asks `subtopic_referenced.first_refusal` and nothing else before falling through to generic segmentation.
p7_1_findings_for_the_register.consequence: For the purposes of P7.1's residual definition, `native` coverage applies to ZERO records through the production path. It changes no residual arithmetic here -- no Frame R record is a ROSES element -- but it means the phrase 'records already covered by a structured source' currently means the ONE Army TDAC parent and nothing else. Related to BUG-12, which already says a native child cannot publish.

On 360335 `component` fires 4 times and `best_family` SELECTS it; on 360334, 3 times. Both sets are refused today by `span_length` (§6.4 rule 3) alone.
